decks.name: LeetCode #36 - Valid Sudoku
decks.description: Determine if a 9x9 Sudoku board is valid

cards.question: Valid Sudoku: Determine if a 9x9 Sudoku board is valid. Only the filled cells need to be validated according to the following rules: Each row must contain the digits 1-9 without repetition, each column must contain the digits 1-9 without repetition, and each of the nine 3x3 sub-boxes must contain the digits 1-9 without repetition. The board is partially filled where empty cells are filled with the '.' character.

solutions.name: Hash Set One Pass
solutions.explanation: Use three arrays of hash sets to track seen numbers in rows, columns, and 3x3 squares. In a single pass through the board, check if the current number exists in any of the three sets before adding it. Most efficient solution with one pass.

solutions.name: Bitmask
solutions.explanation: Use integer bitmasks instead of sets to track seen numbers. Each bit represents a digit 1-9. Use bitwise operations to check and set bits. More space-efficient than hash sets but same time complexity.

solutions.explanation: Check validity in three separate passes: first validate all rows, then all columns, then all 3x3 squares. Each pass uses a hash set to detect duplicates. Less efficient due to multiple passes but most straightforward to understand.
